inbox-acceptor.manifest_template:
# Sentinel-managed deploy template for inbox-acceptor.
#
# Sentinel renders this template by literal substring substitution of
# the placeholders below (each wrapped in doubled underscores) from
# its per-child config at every spawn:
#
# (Comment intentionally avoids writing an example placeholder name in
# the doubled-underscore form — Phase 3.3's secret-validation regex
# scans the whole template for that pattern and would treat an example
# in a doc comment as a required secret. Manager patched this locally
# on the 2026-05-31 cutover attempt; fixed in source here.)
#
#   children: {
#     "inbox-acceptor": {
#       manifest_template: <contents of this file>,
#       default_package:   "<canonical inbox_acceptor.wasm URL>",
#       secrets: {
#         "BEARER_TOKEN":            "...",
#         "DKIM_PRIVATE_KEY":        "...",
#         "LISTEN_ADDR":             "...",
#         "API_HANDLER_MANIFEST":    "...",
#         "MAILBOX_MANIFEST":        "...",
#         "ROUTER_MANIFEST":         "...",
#         "SMTP_ACCEPTOR_MANIFEST":  "...",
#         "SMTP_HANDLER_MANIFEST":   "..."
#       }
#     }
#   }
#
# OPERATOR NOTE — DKIM_PRIVATE_KEY MUST BE JSON-ESCAPED:
#   The PEM is multi-line. Inside the JSON initial_state field, newlines
#   are illegal as raw bytes — they MUST appear as the two-character
#   escape sequence \n. Set DKIM_PRIVATE_KEY in sentinel's secrets map
#   as a single-line string with literal \n escapes, e.g.
#     "DKIM_PRIVATE_KEY": "-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----\nMIIE...\n-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----\n"
#   Sentinel substitutes the value verbatim into the TOML literal string
#   below; theater passes the resulting JSON to the acceptor; serde_json
#   parses \n back to newlines; the PEM reaches DKIM signing intact.
#
# OPERATOR NOTE — BEARER_TOKEN ROTATION:
#   The bearer field accepts a single token or a comma-separated rotation
#   list ("<new>,<old>"). api-handler accepts any token in the list (see
#   api-handler/src/lib.rs:311). Set BEARER_TOKEN as a single-line string;
#   no escape needed.
#
# OPERATOR NOTE — LISTEN_ADDR:
#   host:port string the HTTPS API binds on this host. Pre-frontdoor:
#   "0.0.0.0:443" (public bind). Post-frontdoor cutover: "127.0.0.1:8443"
#   (loopback; frontdoor takes the public :443 and SNI-routes the raw
#   encrypted stream to this backend). The backend still terminates TLS
#   using the cert/key paths in [handler.server_tls] below, regardless of
#   bind address.
#
# OPERATOR NOTE — MANIFEST REFERENCES:
#   *_MANIFEST values are opaque references that theater's
#   resolve_reference dispatches. Three accepted forms:
#     - file paths (/path/to/manifest.toml)        — dev/legacy
#     - https://... URLs                            — release artifacts
#     - store://... references                       — sentinel pre-staged
#   For production sentinel-managed deploy, all four should be https://
#   URLs pointing at the matching release-asset manifest TOMLs on
#   github.com/colinrozzi/inbox/releases.
#
# COEXISTENCE CONSTRAINT:
#   Pre-cutover, this template and the systemd-deployed
#   acceptor/manifest.toml share store_id ("inbox") + base_path. They
#   cannot coexist on the same host — port :443 / :25 contention AND
#   concurrent writers to the same store. Cutover order is "stop systemd;
#   nc sentinel start inbox-acceptor" with a ~5-10s downtime window
#   (CLI/HTTP clients retry; SMTP peers retry per RFC 5321 §4.5.4.1).
#   See the cutover PR description for the full procedure.
#
# WHY initial_state IS A SINGLE-LINE TOML LITERAL (not multi-line):
#   Sentinel embeds this entire template as a STRING value in its own
#   outer manifest, which itself uses TOML triple-quote literal syntax.
#   TOML literal strings have NO escape mechanism for nested triple
#   quotes — if this template uses triple-quote for its inner
#   initial_state, the outer parse closes the wrapping string early
#   ("expected newline" error at the inner triple-quote position).
#   Cutover attempt on 2026-05-31 hit this exact bug and rolled back.
#   Keep initial_state as a single-line single-quote literal. Don't
#   "improve readability" by re-introducing multi-line.

name = "inbox-acceptor"
version = "0.1.0"
package = "__PACKAGE__"
# JSON shape (one-line for nesting-safety; see operator note above):
#   {
#     "bearer_token":           "<token or comma-separated rotation list>",
#     "dkim_private_key":       "<PEM, newlines as \n escapes>",
#     "listen_addr":            "<host:port for HTTPS bind>",
#     "api_handler_manifest":   "<reference>",
#     "mailbox_manifest":       "<reference>",
#     "router_manifest":        "<reference>",
#     "smtp_acceptor_manifest": "<reference>",
#     "smtp_handler_manifest":  "<reference>"
#   }
initial_state = '{"bearer_token":"__BEARER_TOKEN__","dkim_private_key":"__DKIM_PRIVATE_KEY__","listen_addr":"__LISTEN_ADDR__","api_handler_manifest":"__API_HANDLER_MANIFEST__","mailbox_manifest":"__MAILBOX_MANIFEST__","router_manifest":"__ROUTER_MANIFEST__","smtp_acceptor_manifest":"__SMTP_ACCEPTOR_MANIFEST__","smtp_handler_manifest":"__SMTP_HANDLER_MANIFEST__"}'

[[handler]]
type = "runtime"

[[handler]]
type = "tcp"

# server_tls binds the :443 HTTPS listener. Cert + key paths point at
# the let'sencrypt fullchain/privkey on the VPS — the sentinel-host
# operator owns those files at fixed paths (renewed by certbot). Same
# cert pair is used by smtp-handler for STARTTLS on :25 (see the
# release-asset smtp-handler manifest generated by .github/workflows/
# release.yml). If the deploy target ever moves off this host, the
# cert/key paths become per-host config — for now they're hardcoded.
[handler.server_tls]
enabled = true
cert = "/etc/letsencrypt/live/mail.colinrozzi.com/fullchain.pem"
key = "/etc/letsencrypt/live/mail.colinrozzi.com/privkey.pem"

[[handler]]
type = "supervisor"

[[handler]]
type = "rpc"

[[handler]]
type = "store"
base_path = "/mnt/main-volume/inbox/store"
store_id = "inbox"

frontdoor.manifest_template:
name = "frontdoor"
version = "0.1.0"
package = "__PACKAGE__"
initial_state = '__FRONTDOOR_CFG__'

[[handler]]
type = "runtime"

[[handler]]
type = "tcp"

[[handler]]
type = "supervisor"
